name: tripwire-video
description: Product demo video for Tripwire, built with Remotion. Separate from the app, which has zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.audio: node scripts/soundtrack.ts mix && node scripts/soundtrack.ts music && node scripts/soundtrack.ts sfx
scripts.studio: npm run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run audio && npm run cues && npm run render:video && npm run mux
scripts.render:video: remotion render src/index.ts Wide out/_wide-video.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted && remotion render src/index.ts Tall out/_tall-video.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted
